label: First in order
description: Emit the first wired input, in written order, that carried a value; nothing if none did. `checked: review.answer` above `quick: draft.answer` prefers the checked one when both arrive. A join: its inputs are optional and it needs no gate, since "the first of these branches" is when it runs.

outputs.name: value
outputs.description: The first input that carried a value. Closed when none did.

then.message: FirstInOrder '{id}' joins no branches. Wire one input per branch, in the order they take precedence.
